command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify the staged 30x fixture against its pinned sha256 =="
printf '%s  %s\n' 6949939b5937046f1ec7fdcc764dc47df5dd3c35d48b5487470ae3527d21b04a HG00096.chr20_2.0-2.4Mb.30x.bam > b.sha256
sha256sum -c b.sha256

echo "== index the reference (samtools is in this image) and call, restricted to the fixture's region =="
samtools faidx chr20.fa
freebayes -f chr20.fa -r chr20:2000000-2400000 HG00096.chr20_2.0-2.4Mb.30x.bam > freebayes.vcf 2> freebayes.log

# ---- smoke check (inside the task so it can fail it) ----
TOTAL=$(grep -vc '^#' freebayes.vcf)
CONF=$(awk '!/^#/ && $6>=20' freebayes.vcf | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
HDR=$(grep -c '^##fileformat=VCF' freebayes.vcf)
SAMPLE=$(awk '/^#CHROM/{print ($10!="")+0; exit}' freebayes.vcf)
{
  echo "vcf_header           $HDR    want 1"
  echo "sample_column        $SAMPLE want 1       (a genotyped sample column is present)"
  echo "variants_total       $TOTAL  want 1400..2200  (observed 1797; includes freebayes's QUAL~0 tail)"
  echo "confident_QUAL>=20   $CONF   want 680..840    (observed 757)"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$HDR"    -eq 1
test "$SAMPLE" -eq 1
test "$TOTAL"  -ge 1400
test "$TOTAL"  -le 2200
test "$CONF"   -ge 680
test "$CONF"   -le 840
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
